target: a18SumLoadPsngNumXXh, total bus passenger-segment hourly sum
test_access_policy: First-page availability probes only for November. No SNU test target values may be loaded until selection_frozen.json has been saved with model coefficients and predictions. Test target file hashes are recorded only at evaluation.
prior_use: October19-30 previously used and interpreted; now development data only. November2 first-page availability returned one non-target row; October12-16 not previously queried in this project.
refit_after_tuning: Refit the chosen fixed configuration using train+tuning dates only. Save model and all six-date predictions before test data collection.
primary_scope: all 125 from-stop-inside provisional bbox links, both directions; retain modeled zero cells
missing_observation_policy: exclude null; never impute observed null to zero; keep actual zero
base: Training mean of each (route,from-seq,from-id,to-id,hour), weekdays pooled
weekday_history_benchmark: Training same-weekday link-hour mean shrunk toward pooled mean by n/(n+k), k in [0,1,3,10,1000000]
class_features: Preserved segment-entry-hour class flow, q=.5,dorm5772/29613,three external destinations equal; current and 1-hour-lagged features centered by training weekday-frequency mean for each link-hour
background_feature: Historical outside-bbox mean load for the route, weekday and hour divided by the route-hour outside mean; H*(ratio-1). No target-day observations used. Outside traffic includes students and headway effects; it is a background-demand proxy, not a measured nonstudent count.
fit_loss: squared residual plus ridge penalties normalized by each feature mean square; active-set quadratic minimization per route
selection_metric: pooled tuning WAPE on the same observed 125-link 12-22h cells; deterministic ties prefer fewer components, then stronger regularization
hybrid_selection: Choose best hyperparameters of the combined hybrid from tuning only; retain a separately selected historical weekday benchmark and ablations; report all on untouched tests without post-test changes
interpretation: Predictive residual adjustments; no causal identification of student versus background passengers, no inferred homebound/dorm/destination probabilities
remaining_limits: Forward test has one Monday only
Secondary test week is earlier than part of development data and is retrospective
November6 course export is a same-term proxy rather than date-specific attendance or cancellation history
Hourly sums do not validate per-vehicle crowding or shuttle queues
No actual weather/event/day-specific background observation used
